content.title: Terrain Deformation Reveal | Local Anomaly to Approaching Giant Form
content.summary: Let an environmental anomaly initially read as ordinary terrain, then expose only one identity feature. Use a high or distant view to prove the complete geometry and its scale effect on the environment before returning low for a close approach.

quick_start.input_format: Local anomaly of the environment + single identity feature + high-level complete geometric proof + environmental scale influence + low-level close approximation
quick_start.recommended_input: The salt flat first appeared like a bulge in the landform, with only the amber observation window showing; the high-altitude lens proved that it was a giant mobile weather cabin, and finally returned to a low position to allow the cabin to pass near the measurement station.
required_anchors: Open on an environmental deformation that can still be mistaken for terrain.
Reveal one identifying feature while withholding most of the body.
Use one high or wide view to prove the complete geometry and its environmental consequence.
Return to a lower viewpoint for one bounded proximity breach.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Let an environmental anomaly initially read as ordinary terrain, then expose only one identity feature. Use a high or distant view to prove the complete geometry and its scale effect on the environment before returning low for a close approach.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Begin with an environmental disturbance that could still be mistaken for terrain, reveal one identifying feature before the full body, switch to a high or wide view that proves the complete geometry and its scale effect on the environment, then return to a lower viewpoint for one final proximity breach.

invariants.rule: Open on an environmental deformation that can still be mistaken for terrain.
invariants.ablation_failure: A full creature opening removes the reveal.

invariants.rule: Reveal one identifying feature while withholding most of the body.
invariants.ablation_failure: Several features at once collapse the ladder.

invariants.rule: Extend the partial form enough to establish directional body geometry.
invariants.ablation_failure: Jumping directly to the overhead body feels disconnected.

invariants.rule: Use one high or wide view to prove the complete geometry and its environmental consequence.
invariants.ablation_failure: A close body texture gives no spatial proof.

invariants.rule: Return to a lower viewpoint for one bounded proximity breach.
invariants.purpose: Converts distant scale into immediate stakes.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending only overhead remains an illustration.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: green glowing eyes and storm sea
source whirlpool coil and open jaws
